reason: The README describes a tool for extracting and analyzing Bilibili video text, comments, danmaku, transcripts, keyframes, and optional vision descriptions to produce summaries.

summaries.zh: 用于提取哔哩哔哩视频的字幕、评论、弹幕和关键帧，并生成视频分析摘要。
summaries.en: Extracts Bilibili video transcripts, comments, danmaku, and keyframes to produce analysis summaries.

capabilities: accesses Bilibili video metadata, transcripts, comments, and danmaku
downloads or remotely extracts video frames
runs FFmpeg and optional local speech-recognition or vision tools
can use Bilibili QR-code login and configured external APIs
